name: offer
about: A self-serve account's first-month offer, for any of its keys: days left, the allowance and its use, sandboxes left before a card (cardGate: billing is on), the card on file (none, checked, unchecked, failed), where to add one, and a one-line summary.

response.expect: The $1.00 card check is refunded at once. Nothing is charged in your free month (until 11 Dec 2026, up to $80 of use). After that, your card is charged $20 each time your balance falls below $5. Change the amounts or turn auto top-up off on the Billing page.
